text_block_list.text: Screechy! Where are you? Screeeeechy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my way home one night, I spot an
unlikely
group of three students.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I thought that comforting breeze felt
familiar...
Hello, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A Screecher.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser's been seeing this one
bulbul bird
around the academy the past
few days, but
apparently it hasn't shown
up at all today.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I was so sure today was the day
we'd
become friends, and I'd let her
perch on my
shoulder!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The wind that blows for Screechy is
different from
ours. It's delicate, and
changes forever when it
comes into
contact with a different world.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
When a wind changes in nature, it won't
easily
change back.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That's right.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
O-oh... But how can we be sure she's
safe? What
if she's been hurt or she's in
some kind of trouble?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Even if we can't be together, I still want
to check
if she's okay.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. It shouldn't hurt to make
sure she
hasn't been swept up in a storm.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A storm?
Ah! Zephyr, wait!

text_block_list.name: Peculiar Sounds
text_block_list.text: Gyo, gyo, gyo, gyo! Gyoooooh!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wah! What are these noises?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Is it a gh-ghost or something? I heard a
strange
sound coming from over there
earlier...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hey, d-don't be ridiculous!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even if it is a ghost, there's nothing to
be afraid
of.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A sunny spring breeze and a gloomy
winter gale
are both types of wind, both
forms of life
embraced by this Earth.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
To nature, they're equal, and so are
we—we
comprise but a fraction of the
many things that
coexist. We may have
our differences, but they
are trivial.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If we accept things for what they are
without
averting our eyes, then the
mellow breeze is sure
to carry our fears
away.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I see... Coming from a naturalist like you,
that's a
pretty convincing point.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mun, mun! Thanks to you, I'm barely
afraid at all
anymore!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I did? Well, if I managed to chase off
everyone's
fears, then that's a weight off
my wings.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, Tannhauser. Take a look over there.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's Screechy! But wait...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Screechy's with a whole flock of birds.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Screechy... So you were missing all your
friends...

text_block_list.name: Screechy
text_block_list.text: Screech! Screech!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Screechy circles around us as if to say
goodbye,
then flies away towards the
mountains with the
flock of birds.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I think Screechy is back where she
belongs now.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Screechy...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... We're all connected, within the
same wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If you take a stroll through nature, you'll
surely
meet again.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
She's right. If you and Zephyr go hiking
together,
I'm sure Screechy will pop out
to say hi sooner or
later.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right... Thanks, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sob... I guess I'll have to break the news to Coocoo and the others when I get back...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. They were in that tree together,
after all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I have a feeling this might happen
again...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't help feeling that King Halo's
intuition is on
the money.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. For Screechy, being together with
her flock
feels natural. That's why it
makes her happy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I get it now... I wouldn't wanna be
separated from
my friends either.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Let's send Screechy off with a smile!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Voice
text_block_list.text: Cheer... up...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Um... Was that you just now, Zephyr? Or
was it
you, King? Or Zephyr's trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't me. By the way, do you
remember what I
said a little while ago?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A-about accepting things for what they
are
without averting our gaze?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I don't know about the rest of you, but
I'm out of
here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking a confused Yamanin Zephyr by
the hand,
we all panic and flee the
scene together.
